title: Glam Society Music Row-Girls Trip-Outdoor Lounge
description:
Experience The Glam Society, a Taylor-inspired boutique suite on iconic Music Row designed for girls’ trips and bachelorette weekends. Enjoy IG-worthy interiors, curated photo moments, a lighted vanities and shared outdoor lounge. Sleeps 6 with 6 beds and puts you minutes from Broadway, The Gulch, rooftop bars, restaurants, shopping, live music and Nashville nightlife. Stay in the neighborhood where legendary artists, songwriters and producers helped shape Nashville into Music City.

The space
✨ The Glam Society, Nashville's Taylor Inspired Boutique Stay on Music Row

Experience Nashville in true superstar style at this glamorous boutique loft on iconic Music Row. Inspired by Nashville’s music scene and designed with girls’ trips, bachelorette weekends and bestie getaways in mind, this stylish retreat offers the perfect blend of charm and modern luxury.

From IG-worthy photo moments to beautifully curated interiors, every detail has been designed to make your stay unforgettable. Whether you’re getting ready for a night on Broadway, relaxing after a day of exploring, or enjoying coffee before heading out, you’ll feel right at home.

Located just minutes from Broadway, The Gulch, Midtown, Vanderbilt, Belmont University, Nissan Stadium, Bridgestone Arena, and Nashville’s top restaurants, rooftop bars, shopping, and live music, you’ll be in the heart of Music City while enjoying the character and elegance of historic Music Row.

Sleeping Arrangements

Sleeps 6

* 3 Queen beds
* 2 Full beds
* 1 Twin bed

Bedroom 1

* 3 Queen Beds (1 Queen bed and Queen over Queen bunkbed)
* Closet
* Nightstand
* Luggage rack
* Make-up station with 3 separate lighted mirrors

Bedroom Area 2 (cozy converted dining area not walled)
* 2 Full beds(bunk bed)
* 1 Twin bed(trundle)

Bathroom

* Shower/Tub Combo
* Plush towels
* Makeup washcloths
* Makeup wipes
* Shampoo
* Conditioner
* Body wash
* Hand soap
* Hair dryer
* Starter 3 rolls toilet paper

Living Room

* Sofa
* Two accent chairs
* Smart TV
* Designer décor
* Perfect space to relax before your night out

Fully Stocked Kitchen
Everything you need to cook, snack, or celebrate:

* Dining table and chairs
* Refrigerator & freezer
* Oven & cooktop
* Microwave
* Toaster
* Coffee maker with starter coffee supplies
* Wine glasses
* Cookware
* Dishes
* Silverware

Included Amenities

* Free parking for one vehicle
* High-speed Wi-Fi
* Washer & dryer
* Laundry detergent
* Iron & ironing board

Starter supplies are provided for your convenience, including coffee, paper towels (2), toilet paper (3), shampoo, conditioner, body wash, and hand soap.

Exterior security cameras monitor the outdoor patio areas, front and back entrances.

Whether you’re celebrating a bride-to-be, planning a girls’ getaway, attending a concert, visiting Vanderbilt or Belmont, or simply looking for an upscale stay near Broadway, this glamorous loft offers the perfect home base for an unforgettable Nashville experience.

Guest access
You’ll have access to the suite beginning at 4:00 PM on your check-in day with convenient self check-in using an electronic door code. Your unique access code will be sent through the Airbnb app at approximately 11:00 AM on the day of arrival.

Other things to note
Boutique suite on iconic Music Row designed for girls’ trips, bachelorette weekends, birthdays and Nashville getaways. Sleeps 6 with 3 queen beds, 2 full beds plus a twin floor mattress. Features a dedicated vanity and makeup area with lighted mirrors, IG-worthy décor and photo moments, a fully stocked kitchen, Smart TV, high-speed Wi-Fi, washer/dryer and free parking for one vehicle. Guests also have access to a shared outdoor courtyard lounge.
